info.title: http4s — bug #5069 reproduction endpoint
info.description: OpenAPI specification of the endpoint affected by http4s issue #5069 (Accept-Language parser fails on wildcard `*` in 0.22). The bug is triggered when server-side application code explicitly parses the `Accept-Language` request header. The minimal reproduction server used in this bug documentation exposes only `GET /`, but the bug affects any route that calls `Accept-Language.parse(...)`.

servers.description: Local Ember reproduction server (started via deploy_http4s.py)

get.summary: Root route — used to trigger the bug
get.description: On the buggy build (commit `82f8c4b90b08bd6e037b400db52f20b86d666c23`), the route handler calls `Accept-Language.parse(...)` on the incoming request's `Accept-Language` header value. When the header value contains the wildcard token `*;q=0.5`, the parser returns `Left(ParseFailure(...))` and the handler maps this to `500 Internal Server Error`. On the patched build (commit `3a6175224bf96a9e2848cae706295485226590f7`), the parser returns `Right(Accept-Language(...))` and the handler responds with `200 OK`.

parameters.name: Accept-Language
parameters.description:
An `Accept-Language` header value containing the wildcard token `*;q=0.5`, as recommended by MDN and produced by major HTTP clients (Firefox, Safari, Spring's `LocaleContextResolver`). The exact value used in the reproduction is the verbatim MDN example.

The wildcard `*;q=0.5` is the trigger: without it, the parser succeeds on both buggy and patched builds; with it, the parser fails on buggy builds and succeeds on patched builds.

200.description: PATCHED response. Returned by the Ember server at commit `3a6175224bf96a9e2848cae706295485226590f7` and later, when the `Accept-Language` header parses successfully. The response body echoes the canonical rendering of the parsed value, confirming that the parser round-trips the wildcard token.

schema.example: Parsed Accept-Language successfully: fr-CH, fr;q=0.9, en;q=0.8, de;q=0.7, *;q=0.5

500.description:
BUGGY response. Returned by the Ember server at commit `82f8c4b90b08bd6e037b400db52f20b86d666c23` when the `Accept-Language` header value contains the wildcard token `*;q=0.5`. The response body contains the message of the underlying `ParseFailure`, which surfaces the parser's internal error state.

In a production application, the body would typically be a generic `500` page (the parse failure is returned as a `ParseResult` rather than thrown as an exception, so it does not appear in server logs unless explicitly logged).

schema.example: Accept-Language parse failure: Invalid Accept-Language header: Error(0,NonEmptyList(InRange(0,A,Z), InRange(0,a,z)))
